angle: compile-time interface satisfaction check — var _ AllocatorExtended = &Allocator{}: what breaks if GetStats() is absent
difficulty_notes: The question asks: if GetStats() were removed from stable.Allocator while keeping the var _ assertion, which files fail to compile? The correct answer is only allocator_stable.go itself — the var _ blank-identifier assertion is a compile-time check local to the file. External callers of stable.Allocator do not store it as an AllocatorExtended or call GetStats() directly. Models unfamiliar with the blank-identifier interface assertion pattern will hallucinate that all files importing the stable package or using AllocatorExtended are affected.
